# Reusable projection patterns and cross-functional programs

## Patterns

### undefined (candidate)

One configurable command center per enterprise function, so a new function does not require a new dashboard.

- Duplication rule: The pattern reads canonical objects. It never stores a function-local copy of a work item, decision, or finding.
- Prohibited content: Any measure of an individual's activity; A blended function health score; Records outside the function's authorized object scope

### undefined (candidate)

Show capacity, obligations, and blockers for a team without observing the people in it.

- Duplication rule: Reads the same work items the individual sees. No manager-only shadow record exists.
- Prohibited content: Individual productivity scores; Activity or presence telemetry; Automated performance evaluation

### undefined (candidate)

Give one person the obligations they personally owe, in a defensible order.

- Duplication rule: Identical to the Action Center contract. There is one obligation projection, not two.
- Prohibited content: Engagement scoring; Opaque model ranking

### undefined (candidate)

Give several functions one shared view of a programme without any of them owning the records.

- Duplication rule: The programme view is a projection. Editing happens in the canonical register, never in the programme surface.
- Prohibited content: A programme-local copy of any canonical object; A single programme health score
